description: This file contains functions and types for performing asynchronous security audits, including filesystem permission checks, plugin and skill code safety analysis, and container port inspections within the openclaw project.

classes.name: SecurityAuditFinding
classes.description: Type representing a security audit finding with check ID, severity, title, detail, and optional remediation.

methods.name: expandTilde
methods.description: Expands tilde in file paths to the home directory based on environment variables.

methods.name: readPluginManifestExtensions
methods.description: Reads and parses plugin manifest to extract extension paths.

methods.name: formatCodeSafetyDetails
methods.description: Formats code safety scan findings into a readable string.

methods.name: readChannelCommandSetting
methods.description: Retrieves specific command settings for a channel from the configuration.

methods.name: isChannelPluginConfigured
methods.description: Checks if a channel plugin is properly configured and enabled.

methods.name: listInstalledPluginDirs
methods.description: Lists plugin directories installed in the extensions directory.

methods.name: resolveToolPolicies
methods.description: Resolves applicable sandbox tool policies based on configuration and context.

methods.name: normalizePluginIdSet
methods.description: Normalizes plugin IDs into a set of lowercase strings.

methods.name: resolveEnabledExtensionPluginIds
methods.description: Determines which plugin IDs are enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: collectAllowEntries
methods.description: Collects allowlist entries from configuration objects.

methods.name: hasExplicitPluginAllow
methods.description: Checks if allowlist entries explicitly permit a plugin.

methods.name: hasProviderPluginAllow
methods.description: Checks if allowlist entries from providers permit plugins.

methods.name: isPinnedRegistrySpec
methods.description: Determines if a registry spec string is pinned to a specific version.

methods.name: readInstalledPackageVersion
methods.description: Reads the version of an installed package from its package.json.

methods.name: buildCodeSafetySummaryCacheKey
methods.description: Builds a cache key string for code safety summaries based on directory and included files.

methods.name: getCodeSafetySummary
methods.description: Retrieves or computes a code safety summary for a directory, utilizing cache.

methods.name: listWorkspaceSkillMarkdownFiles
methods.description: Recursively lists SKILL.md files within a workspace directory.
